skylite.config.bars.hint: Position and size are edited in game: F8 ("Move the bars") or /skylite edit. LMB — drag, wheel — width of the bar under the cursor, Ctrl+wheel — its thickness, RMB — color.
skylite.config.info.hint: Values the server itself sends: the lines appear above the bars (or in the panel); FPS/ping — separately, in a corner; Speed — its own plate, draggable in the bar editor.
skylite.config.alerts.hint: Words separated by commas. The alert fires when a chat message contains any of them (case does not matter).
skylite.opt.restore.label: Before optimization
skylite.opt.section.advisor: Advisor: what is left to squeeze
skylite.opt.section.mods: Mods that do more than us
skylite.opt.bench.title: Measurement, 10 seconds
skylite.opt.bench.hint: First number is the average, second the dips
skylite.editor.title: SkyLite — bar positions
skylite.editor.hint1: LMB — drag · wheel — width · Ctrl+wheel — thickness · RMB — color
skylite.editor.hint3: The Speed plate is dragged the same way; toggle it in the settings.
skylite.tip.bars.style: The look of all three bars: classic, rounded, capsule, gloss, minimal, framed.
skylite.tip.bars.color_hp: Fill colour of the health (HP) bar.
skylite.tip.bars.color_mana: Fill colour of the mana bar.
skylite.tip.bars.color_xp: Fill colour of the XP bar.
skylite.tip.bars.color_text: Colour of the numbers on the bars.
skylite.tip.bars.width_hp: Width of the HP bar; also adjustable with the mouse wheel in the editor (F8).
skylite.tip.bars.width_mana: Width of the mana bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.width_xp: Width of the XP bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.thickness_hp: Thickness of the HP bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.thickness_mana: Thickness of the mana bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.thickness_xp: Thickness of the XP bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.show_numbers: Draw the current values right on the bars.
skylite.tip.bars.number_background: A dark plate behind the numbers — keeps them readable on any background.
skylite.tip.bars.track_opacity: How visible the bar track is; 0% is fully transparent.
skylite.tip.bars.glyphs: ❤ and ✎ glyphs next to the numbers.
skylite.tip.bars.outline: A thin outline around the bars.
skylite.tip.bars.pulse: The bar pulses when HP or mana is almost gone.
skylite.tip.info.defense: The Defense line from the sidebar.
skylite.tip.info.area: The name of the current area or island.
skylite.tip.info.cookie: Time left on the Cookie Buff.
skylite.tip.info.godpot: Time left on the God Potion.
skylite.tip.info.speed: The Speed plate; drag it in the editor (F8).
skylite.tip.info.ping_fps: FPS and real ping counters in a corner of the screen.
skylite.tip.info.corner: Which corner shows the FPS and ping.
skylite.tip.alerts.enabled: The master switch for alerts (sound and flash).
skylite.tip.alerts.sound: A sound when an alert fires.
skylite.tip.alerts.flash: A quick on-screen flash when an alert fires.
skylite.tip.alerts.keywords: Comma-separated words: the alert fires on a message containing any of them.
skylite.tip.chat.highlight: Highlight chat messages that mention your nickname.
skylite.tip.chat.filter: Hide chat messages containing any of the words below.
skylite.tip.chat.repeats: Hide identical messages that arrive within 10 seconds.
skylite.tip.chat.phrases: Comma-separated words: messages containing them never show up in chat.
skylite.tip.hud.hearts: Hide the vanilla hearts — the HP bar replaces them.
skylite.tip.hud.xp_bar: Hide the vanilla XP bar above the hotbar.
skylite.tip.hud.stats_line: Hide Hypixel's stats line at the bottom (the bars already show it).
skylite.tip.opt.profile.balanced: A gentle preset: fewer particles and shadows, almost the same picture.
skylite.tip.opt.profile.performance: Cuts graphics harder: minimal particles, no see-through leaves or biome blend.
skylite.tip.opt.profile.maximum: Everything from Performance plus AO off and distances 8/6.
skylite.tip.opt.restore: Put the game settings back to the state before the first profile was applied.
skylite.tip.opt.mod: Opens the mod's Modrinth page — download the .jar and drop it into the mods folder.
skylite.tip.opt.area.toggle: Apply a profile automatically when the location changes, per the rules below.
skylite.tip.opt.area.default: The profile for locations that match none of the rules.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.title: Measures average FPS and dips over 10 seconds; keep the screen open.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.current: The latest measurement: average FPS and the 1% slowest frames.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.prev: The previous measurement — compare before and after.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.delta: The difference between the two measurements.
